categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of display driver chips. Its product portfolio includes integrated display chips such as TFT-LCD DDIC/TDDI, AMOLED display driver chips, touch chips, and MicroLED chips, as well as discrete display chips including display driver chips, power management chips, and timing control chips. These products serve various end markets including smart wearables, smartphones, industrial control displays, tablets, laptops, TVs, and automotive displays.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates a fabless model, focusing on chip design and outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries like SMIC, TSMC, and others. It has developed 19 core proprietary technologies covering image compression, low power charge recovery, reduced photomask layers, built-in capacitors, image enhancement, and advanced AMOLED driving techniques. The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, with a structured 'pre-research, development, mass production' pipeline to maintain technological leadership and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major panel manufacturers such as BOE Technology, Tianma Microelectronics, Visionox, and other well-known display module companies like Yihua Display and Zhongxian Intelligent. The company serves diverse markets including consumer electronics (smartphones, wearables), industrial control, automotive displays, IT devices (tablets, laptops), TVs, and commercial displays. The customer base is concentrated, with the top five customers accounting for over 50% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Mainland China, with significant business in Shanghai, Beijing, Xi'an, Hefei, and Shenzhen. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and serves markets in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macau. The company’s products are used globally, but its main manufacturing and sales activities are concentrated in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, positioned midstream in the supply chain. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and downstream assembly partners. The company collaborates closely with upstream suppliers like SMIC, TSMC, and others to optimize manufacturing processes and cost structures.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation in display driver chips, focusing on high resolution, high refresh rate, low power consumption, and high integration. It is expanding product lines to cover emerging display technologies such as Mini/Micro-LED and AR/AI glasses. Strategic R&D investments target enhancing AMOLED and TFT-LCD product matrices and accelerating new product commercialization. The company also plans to grow through strategic acquisitions to broaden its product portfolio and strengthen supply chain integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit products, specifically display driver chips and related semiconductor components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, selling mainly to panel manufacturers and module assemblers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. Additionally, the company earns income from technology development services and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics is one of the leading domestic display driver chip suppliers in China, competing with other integrated circuit design firms and international players in the display semiconductor sector. It holds a strong position due to its comprehensive product coverage across display technologies and sizes, robust R&D capabilities, and strategic partnerships with major panel manufacturers. The company is recognized as a pioneer in domestic display chip production and is actively advancing the localization of high-end display chip technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 507.4 million, representing a 5.61% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.43 million, a decline of 69.38% compared to the previous year, mainly due to pricing pressures and increased competition. R&D expenses accounted for 12.98% of revenue, reflecting a 15.48% increase in R&D investment. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 1.79 billion with net assets of RMB 1.57 billion, indicating a stable but competitive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies that enable low power consumption, small chip area, high reliability, strong electrostatic discharge resistance, and support for high resolution and refresh rates. Its products are designed to meet diverse application needs from small wearable devices to large automotive and commercial displays. The company’s integrated solutions and comprehensive product portfolio provide customers with cost-effective, high-performance display driver chips, supporting the domestic substitution of imported chips and enabling cutting-edge display technologies.
